items.question: By what method must the secret teaching be disclosed while avoiding oral proclamation?
premises: The teaching may be written down before disclosure.
The written teaching should be shown on the ground.
The teaching must not be revealed orally into the ear.
items.inference: Therefore, the secret teaching is to be transmitted by silent written display rather than by spoken utterance.
uncertainties: Whether bhūmau implies writing directly on the earth or displaying a written surface upon it is not explicit.
items.plain_english: Having written it down, one should show it on the ground, and one should not reveal it by speaking into the ear.
